model.title: Wyoming Education Trust Modernization Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Cynthia Lummis (R-WY)

summary.text: The bill would modify how Wyoming manages its permanent school fund, which was established from federal land grants when the state was created. It would allow Wyoming to use investment earnings from the fund to support public schools, not just interest payments, giving the state greater flexibility in funding education.
